description: Web page to Markdown, scrape a website to clean LLM-ready text. Fetch a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (navigation, scripts and footers removed), with the title. Plain fetch, no JavaScript rendering. Obeys the site's robots.txt. Long pages are cut at max_chars. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: page_to_markdown
